entries.en: Later, this will magically transform into an enlightening description.
Most of the files on this research computer are heavily encrypted, but several recent log entries are accessible.

The larger of Mars' two tiny moons has been built up as an orbital port. Initially developed by a consortium of European and Russian commercial backers, administration was handed over to the Systems Alliance in 2163.

Today Deimos serves as an entrepot for cargo moving to and from the surface, as well as a customs inspection and medical quarantine for immigrants and visitors. All departures from Mars must pass through Deimos' screening facilities; given the possibility of private explorers discovering Prothean artifacts, all baggage undergoes a thorough inspection.

The Systems Alliance 1st Fleet, nominally based in Arcturus, maintains a cruiser squadron and frigate flotilla at Deimos. They are tasked with protecting the Prothean ruins and assisting customs enforcement.

Bonestell Mars Observation Platform was built in 2150, with major funding provided by the national space agencies of the United States and Japan. It is currently administered by the Systems Alliance, which assumed control of all Martian interface facilities in 2163. The SA is now solely responsible for the security of Mars' Prothean excavation sites.

Bonestell Platform maintains an orbit that keeps it on the opposite side of the planet from the natural satellite of Deimos. That moon has been built up as a communications hub and shipping port. Bonestell serves the same communications role on the hemisphere of Mars facing away from Deimos. Since all commercial traffic is channeled through the security checkpoints on Deimos, Bonestell lacks significant port facilities.

To change the weapon Shepard is using, first press and hold %WEAPONSWHEEL.
Press %GRENADE to throw a grenade. Wait for timed detonation or press %GRENADE again to detonate. Throw a grenade at the husk's feet now.
Press %VEHICLEREPAIR to repair the Mako using omni-gel. The Electronics skill increases the amount repaired.
You cannot exit the Mako unless it is parked on level terrain.
Press %FIRSTAID to heal injured members of your squad. Each use consumes 1 unit of medi-gel.
Run to the waypoint to take cover behind the rock. Cover protects you from enemy fire.
Press %MAPMENU to access the map for a tactical view of the area.
You have gained a level! When you gain a level, press %PAUSEMENU to open the Squad Screen and improve your squad's abilities.
Press %PAUSEMENU to go to the Squad screen to spend talent points for new squad members.
Click on a talent to spend a point and improve the highlighted Talent.
Press (%MELEE) to rifle-butt or pistol-whip any enemies in your way.
Press and hold %STORM in combat to sprint short distances.

Select a reply in the conversation wheel. Left clicking a reply will cause your character to allow the other character to finish before responding. Right clicking a reply will cause your character to interrupt and respond immediately.
During combat, Storm lets you sprint at high speed for short distances. Press and hold %STORM while moving to Storm.
Enter cover by pushing against the rock with your weapon drawn.
Press %CROUCH to crouch or stand up. You will automatically crouch when taking cover behind low objects.
Press %ORDERSSQUADMOVE1 or %ORDERSSQUADMOVE2 to send a squadmate ahead. Then press %ORDERSSQUADFOLLOW to call them back.
Press %ABILITIESWHEEL to bring up the Power Wheel and pause the game. The Power Wheel lets you use the powers and special abilities of your squad.

With the Power Wheel open, right click and drag the mouse to aim at a target. Click on an ability to select it. You may have 1 power or ability selected for each squad member. Press %ABILITIESWHEEL to unpause the game and use selected powers.

The Mission Computer accesses your journal, map, and other important screens.
Flashing screens have new updates.
Press %PAUSEMENU to access the Equipment screen. The Equipment screen lets you change or upgrade weapons, armor, and other gear for each member of your squad.
Use Citadel Rapid Transit to jump between major locations. As you explore the Citadel, more locations will unlock.
Use %TABNEXT and %TABBACK to cycle through the buttons on the screen. Press %TABACTIVATE to activate the highlighted button.
Are you sure you wish to exit the game?
You will lose all unsaved progress by exiting the game. Do you wish to continue?
Discards any unaccepted changes and returns to the main menu

If you are too slow making your responses in the mini-game, or make a wrong response, you will fail.
If you fail the mini-game you will need to interact with the object again and use omni-gel to open or access it.
If nobody in your squad has a high enough rank in the required talent, you cannot access or open the object.
Equip your Sniper Rifle and shoot the gas bag creature ahead. Press and hold %TACTICSHUD to pause the game and begin weapon switch.

All squad members earn talent points when you gain a level.

Select the squad member you want to train and click on a talent to improve it. Mouse over a talent for information on it.

Squad Orders can be used to tactically maneuver your squadmates in combat.
%ORDERSSQUADATTACK: Attack your target.
%ORDERSSQUADMOVE1 or %ORDERSSQUADMOVE2: Have a specific squadmate move to a point or attack the targetted enemy.
%ORDERSSQUADFOLLOW: Regroup and follow you.

Orders can also be given to squad mates individually. Press %ORDERSWHEEL to bring up the Orders Wheel and pause the game. The Orders Wheel lets you give your squad tactical orders. Right click and drag the mouse to aim at a target enemy or destination. Assign orders to your squadmates by clicking on the appropriate icon. Press %ORDERSWHEEL to close the Orders Wheel and confirm any orders.

Press %ORDERSWHEEL to bring up the Orders Wheel and pause the game. The Orders Wheel lets you give your squad tactical orders. Right click and drag the mouse to aim at the combat dummy. Then, click each squadmate's Attack icon. Press %ORDERSWHEEL to close the Orders Wheel and confirm the target order.
A target order can also be given in combat by aiming at a target and pressing %ORDERSSQUADATTACK.

Press %ABILITIESWHEEL to bring up the Power Wheel. Left click and drag one of your powers into one of the slots in the quick slots list to quick-map that power. Press %ABILITIESWHEEL to close the Power Wheel. Press a quick slot key to use any power mapped to that quick slot.
Click on a talent to spend points and improve that ability. Mouse over a talent for more information. Select each squad member to spend their points.
You've been warned about the presence of underground explosives surrounding one of the torches. You'll need to exit the Mako and proceed on foot.
The blasting caps are equipped with proximity detectors. The closer you get, the more likely they'll go off.

Adjusts combat difficulty by helping the player to aim at targets. High means you get lots of help in targeting. Low means you get very little help.

Powers can be mapped to Quick Slots from the Power Wheel.
Press %ABILITIESWHEEL to open the power wheel.
Drag and drop a power into a quick slot to map it to that quick slot.
When finished, press %ABILITIESWHEEL to close the power wheel.
Press a quick slot hotkey in combat to use the power in that quick slot.
